_note: Industry, street, ownership, events, moat and critiques for the M&M initiation. Standing on 30-Sep-2026; later items only in updates/later-facts.json.

pv.note: Apr-Aug 2026 growth is flattered by a weak base: buyers deferred purchases in Aug-Sep 2025 ahead of the GST cut. ICRA (Oct-2026 reiteration, not used) and CRISIL (May-2026: +5-7%) expected modest full-year growth.

gst.detail: 56th GST Council (3-Sep-2025): SUVs (>4m, >1,200cc petrol / >1,500cc diesel) from 28% + 22% cess to a flat 40%; small cars from 28% + cess to 18%; EVs stay at 5%; GST on tractors and commercial vehicles also cut. M&M cut ICE SUV prices by Rs81,000-1.56 lakh from 6-Sep-2025.
gst.src: https://www.businesstoday.in/auto/story/mahindra-mahindra-passes-full-gst-benefits-to-suv-buyers-following-gst-20-reset-492876-2025-09-06 ; AR FY26 MD&A (tractor GST cut, Sep-2025)

rareEarth.detail: China restricted rare-earth magnet exports from Apr-2025; Rajesh Jejurikar (May-2025) called it 'nuanced, not alarming', with M&M using stocked sub-assemblies and saying supply was covered through Mar-2026; China eased curbs for India in Aug-2025; the government announced a Rs7,280 cr rare-earth permanent magnet scheme. No disclosed M&M production loss.

commodities.detail: West Asia conflict: Brent near $100 in Mar-2026 (Strait of Hormuz fears); steel +24%, rubber +30% in CY26 to July; aluminium fell ~20% in 8-10 days in late June when the war was reported to be stopping. MOSL (30-Sep-2026) flags El Nino and a renewed escalation in West Asia as risks to the sector's margin recovery.

ev.detail: Industry e-SUV penetration ~9% in Q1FY27 (2-2.5% a few quarters earlier); M&M 12% of its SUVs, No.1 by e-SUV revenue share (44.3%). PLI for EVs supports margins; management expects PLI to taper as scale builds. CAFE-III norms from Apr-2027.

euFta.detail: India-EU trade deal (Jan-2026) cut duties on European cars over time; auto stocks fell up to 4% on the day on fears for premium SUVs.

street._method: Brokers that disclose a method use a sum of the parts: the standalone business on P/E (Motilal Oswal 24x autos / 26x tractors on Mar-28E; Anand Rathi 22x Mar-28E EPS incl. MEAL; Choice 25x FY28E EPS) or EV/EBITDA (ICICI Direct 15x FY28E), plus listed subsidiaries at market or house targets and others at investment value, less a 20-25% holding discount.

moat: No.1 by SUV revenue share for three years; Thar, Scorpio, XUV 7XO, XEV 9S carry waiting lists; capacity, not demand, is the constraint
~43-45% domestic share for decades through Mahindra and Swaraj brands, ~1,000+ dealers, financing via M&M Finance; core tractor PBIT 17-21% through cycles
52% share, 12+ years as No.1 by volume
Auto PBIT 9-10% (Q1FY27 7.1%) is good for India but well below tractors; commodity shocks pass through with a lag
INGLO platform, No.1 e-SUV revenue share; but profits depend on PLI today and the platform needs scale; Tata, Hyundai, Maruti and imports are competing
Exits from SsangYong, Sampo, Erkunt; 18% ROE hurdle; but Rs7,101 cr of cumulative impairments and Rs15,925 cr committed to MEAL
critiques: SUV growth guidance of 'mid-to-high teens' has been given for three years running; with capacity rising 2x by FY31 the company needs share gains in a market growing 5-7%.
The tractor cycle is two strong years old and the 2026 monsoon was 87% of normal: FY28 volumes are at risk.
Standalone margins are diluted by e-SUVs built for MEAL at ~0.4% PBIT; a sum of the parts that values MEAL separately must not also credit M&M with EV profits.
Listed stakes (Tech Mahindra, M&M Finance) are a large part of value; both have their own issues (GAM: Tech Mahindra SELL Rs1,430; M&M Finance HOLD Rs330).
The 2024-25 re-rating (core P/E ~21x) assumed sustained 20%+ EPS growth; FY27E EPS growth is ~7%.
Holding-company discounts are a convention: the market has never paid full value for M&M's stakes.

gaps: Revenue and margin by product line (ICE SUVs vs pickups vs exports) are not disclosed; the build uses one ICE/LCV realisation pool.
Standalone automotive and farm PBIT before FY23 and quarterly segment data before Q3FY25 were not collected.
Tractor and auto volumes for Q2FY26-Q3FY26 by quarter were not collected (only FY totals).
Named institutional holders (beyond the trusts and LIC's board nominee) for Jun-2026 were not available without BSE access.
Exact quarterly split of income from investments for Q1FY24 is unknown (not needed for the as-of window).

Mahindra Susten, Aerostructures, Accelo and Classic Legends are carried at M&M's cost; no fresh third-party valuations by 30-Sep-2026 were found (management valued the 'growth gems' at Rs55,000-56,000 cr in Nov-2025, a figure we do not use).
MEAL's CCPS conversion valuation (~Rs40,400 cr) is inferred from the investors' final stakes (4.58% for Rs1,850 cr; 2.97% for Rs1,200 cr); the company did not publish the conversion price.
Broker methods for ICICI Securities (institutional), Nomura and CLSA are not disclosed in the sources found; Nomura/CLSA targets come from a secondary report.
The completion date and price adjustment of the truck & bus slump sale to SML are not known; our standalone forecasts keep the division.
conflicts: Standalone EBITDA: Screener shows Rs22,495 cr for FY26 because it includes investment income (Rs2,190 cr) and the loss from investments (Rs677 cr); the company/CRISIL figure is Rs20,977 cr. We use Rs20,983 cr (patched Screener, = company within rounding).
EPS basis: company basic EPS Rs130.18 (FY26, 120.13 cr weighted shares excl. ESOP trust); we use Rs125.76 on all 124.35 cr issued shares, as market value does.
Tractor volume Q1FY26: 1,32,964 in the Jul-2025 release vs 1,34,089 in the Jul-2026 release (restated to include Gromax); we use the latest.
ICICI Direct's SOTP text says a 20% holding discount; its table applies 25%.
